content.fact: To authenticate Azure Speech service, use environment variables to store SPEECH_KEY and ENDPOINT or SPEECH_REGION.
content.quote: You need to authenticate your application to access Azure AI services. This article shows you how to use environment variables to store your credentials. You can then access the environment variables from your code to authenticate your application.

content.fact: When using API keys, store them securely in Azure Key Vault, rotate keys regularly, and restrict access using RBAC and network restrictions.
content.quote: Use API keys with caution. Don't include the API key directly in your code, and never post it publicly. If using API keys, store them securely in Azure Key Vault, rotate the keys regularly, and restrict access to Azure Key Vault using role based access control and network access restrictions.
